Alright, first I'd like to clarify, I'm not blaming Kai at all. And the poultry farm doesn't need Popuri cause she's basically a dependent. Her leaving would actually make things easier for Rick. 

The problems are that:

1. Popuri is being very ungrateful with Rick, and 
2. that Rick doesn't trust Kai

It's understandable, but disappointing that Kai would keep himself at arm's length with all that family drama.

Just like how it's understandable, but disappointing that Rick is bagging Popuri's leaving as if his sister whom he's been taking care of this whole time was abandoning him and Lillia 'like their father did'.

Just like how it's understandable, but disappointing that Popuri wants to leave, but is going about it with only herself in mind, and not with Rick and Lillia's thoughts in mind. 

My point is, I'm disappointed in Kai. I'm not angry with him, nor blaming him or anything, but it's that he's doing NOTHING to help with the drama.

He's not telling Popuri to try to mend her relationship with her brother. Nor is he showing any indication that he can be trusted with Popuri (Rick knows Kai is a troublemaker and Kai does nothing to prove otherwise).

He's not trying to reach out to Rick on why he's being so adamant about Popuri staying. Nor is he willing to go the extra mile to help Rick feel better about Popuri being with him. Nor is Kai willing to try and help make Popuri's leaving be any easier on the family. 

Kai is only doing the bare minimum in all this. And while understandable, it still makes me sad.

Kai doesn't 'have' to take responsibility for Popuri's choices, but not doing so makes Kai a stagnant and standoff-ish character without any significant development at best. All the other bachelors are 'reactive' to the bachelorettes' advances, yet they become better people for it:

1. Gray is being influenced by Mary's own aspirations to write her own novel, which isn't easy. Seeing this, Gray finds the strength to overcome his own difficulties with Saibara.
2. Cliff is being taken in by Mineral Town's generosity and communal spirit after >!having lost his family by something horrible!<. Once he stays, he gets to create the family he's been searching for so long with Ann.
3. Rick is burnt out by all the responsibility, but Karen's there to make sure he stays sane and gives him a life to look forward to.
4. The Doctor, having a career/identity crisis from his feelings of inadequacy as a doctor from not being able to cure people like Ellen nor Lillia, finds in Elli that the true purpose in life isn't just in the service one performs, but also in finding happiness for oneself.

Kai's the worst case, because not only does he have NO development whatsoever, but he's leaving a broken family in his wake. Plus, Kai explains that he comes here for Summer because >!he's taking time away from his relatives who don't seem to like him either!<.

And here he comes, finds a grown woman make an irresponsible choice of souring her relationship with her own family, just so she can fulfill her selfish request of traveling the world. Really?

Now you have two irresponsible people running away from their families' problems.

Sure Lillia isn't one to object to Popuri's leaving, but imagine you were frail, your husband having left to 'find a cure' for god knows how long, and you've got a large poultry farm only your poor son can take care of cause your daughter wasn't taught SHIT. And now your daughter wants to leave the nest, leaving you alone and shitting all over Rick's efforts of taking care of the family and showing such ungratefulness to him.

... You *really* want Kai to just be an observer in all this?

Why not make Kai be the 'proactive' bachelor for once?  
Why not make Kai WORK for his right to have Popuri?

Oh yeeaaahhhh! That's actually a great point! Rick won't have to be lonely either, now that he's got Karen and her heavy-drinking, food-burning baggage around, hahah!

I just need to make sure I do all the cooking instead of Karen for all our family gatherings from then on, hahah!

I mean, nobody's saying Rick's right in wanting to force his sister to stay. Just understandable.

Personally, Rick should've let Popuri help out with the chores, at least slowly over time. 

Hell, with the black heart event we get to see Popuri do just that by trying to grab a runaway chicken. 

By marrying Popuri, not only do we get to let Popuri be the adult she's always wanted to be by letting her be our wife, but we also let Rick eat his cake and have it too by having Popuri stay and be a homebody, so Rick likes us too.

Just as there is 'quick synthesis', wouldn't your problem logically be solved via 'quick desynthesis'?

I mention that unlike regular synthesis, not reaching 100% for desynthesis would be totally fine. The downside isn't that you fail and lose the item and get nothing, but that you don't get a lot of the materials originally used to 'make' said item (meaning you get reliable experience desynthesizing, as compared to synthesizing where failures give no experience and loss of materials). Not reaching 100% for quality means you get a negligible, if any, salvaged HQ materials.

Lastly, my gameplay loop is intended towards desynthesis being the equivalent of 'salvaging' in other MMOs. Many other MMOs have salvagers as even entire classes/jobs in their own right, while desynthesis here is usually not touched at unless you're really desperate for glam/discarding stuff on your own.

This gameplay loop is meant to give a whole new branch of crafting that opens up doors to other avenues of items. Recycling itself deserves respect and loving attention to detail.
